Methodology and sources

Hospital identities, addresses, types, and ownership come from federal facility data. Bed counts are certified beds from CMS provider data and are labeled with their source period on each detail page. Website links have automated identity evidence; this is not a guarantee of facility-specific attribution. Known ambiguous links are withheld pending research. Social profiles are links found on the hospital's own website; where an account is shared across a health system, that is noted on the link. Hospitals without a verified link simply show fewer icons. This directory is research infrastructure for hospital price transparency work under 45 CFR Part 180.
